laws.rule: Parque Natural Balboa, Planes de Renderos: ISTU expressly excepts this park from its general prohibition on companion animals. Do not assume the exception applies at other ISTU parks. The Balboa page says its merenderos food-serving area stays open until 22:00; this is not an opening promise for every park facility.

sources.supports: Read directly: no alcohol/tobacco/intoxicated entry, no weapons or unauthorised vendors, pool swimwear requirement, Balboa pet exception and recommended but not compulsory advance walk reservations.
